thread:
arya: Working on a lightweight 'Fallback Inspector' for rollout pages. Goal: explain decision, link to audit entry, let operators simulate in a sandbox. Want terse, scannable UI not a data dump.
chris: Good. Must include the matching condition + the values that tripped it (p95, errors, quota left). Show a small sparkline of the triggering metric.
nate: Keep it privacy-safe. Mask user IDs and request payloads; surface only hashed ids or aggregate counts. Security wants an opt-in to show sensitive context.
infra-bot: infra-bot: canary deploy 0.24.1 succeeded :white_check_mark:
arya: Proposed minimal inspector sections: 1) Decision summary (who/when/what target) 2) Trigger detail (rule id, signal snapshot) 3) Operator actions (overrides + TTL) 4) Replay widget (dry-run) 5) Audit link (exportable CSV).
chris: For Trigger detail, show a compact table: {signal, value, threshold, margin}. Example: p95=1400ms, threshold=1200ms, margin=+200ms. That helps triage.
nate: Replay must be non-destructive and rate-limited. It should accept the original request context (sanitized) and return a "simulated routing path" and the tokens/cost estimate. No live model calls, use a recorded decision engine in sandbox.
ops-lee: How do quotas factor? If a customer is at quota, should fallback route to a cheaper model or hard fail? We need a default precedence and a per-rollout override.
arya: Suggest precedence doc: operator-override > maintenance-mode > quota-fallback > perf-trigger > error-trigger > reject. We'll surface precedence in the inspector with an icon for the rule that fired.
chris: Add hysteresis: when a rule triggers, start a cooldown window and show "cooldown remaining". Also show why a re-eval didn't re-route (e.g., within cooldown).
nate: Retention: keep decision records 60 days by default, org-configurable to 365 for enterprise. Make exportability explicit.
arya: UX nit: for sticky overrides show small chips in timeline: "override by @lee (5m) - reason: smoke test" and include a quick Revert action.
ops-lee: Revert should be optimistic and documented: create an audit entry when revert requested, and queue the revert for operator confirmation if it affects >X traffic.
chris: We also need a lightweight API for the console to request the decision payload: /rollouts/{id}/decisions?since=... that returns list of decision snapshots. Backend will strip PII.
arya: Mocked policy sample for discussion (displayed in UI only as a read-only snippet):
```json
{
  "policy_id": "rbf-77",
  "conditions": [
    {"metric": "latency_p95_ms", "op": ">=", "value": 1200},
    {"metric": "error_rate", "op": ">=", "value": 0.04}
  ],
  "action": {"type": "route", "target": "opt-small-v2", "ttl_seconds": 300, "cooldown_seconds": 180}
}
```
chris: For the UI show TTL and cooldown as separate badges with tooltips. Also a tiny cost-delta preview (estimated tokens/cost at current rate) when routing changes target.
nate: Security ask: add a toggle on rollout settings "Expose decision payload to console" default off for new orgs; admins can enable. Log any enables as security events.
arya: Follow-ups: API contract for decision snapshots, retention settings in org admin, mock screenshots with inspector open, and a short playbook for ops-handles (revert flow). I'll drop mock images tomorrow.
ops-lee: Thanks. This looks actionable. Tag me for the mock review.
chris: I'll sketch the badge styles and small table.
arya: Great. Closing for now 07: we'll reconvene after mocks.
